comment: Source is not published. Read against docs/modules/KlokSpidMkII/Manual.md at tag v2.6.13. No family is given for the eight outputs: what a given output carries is whatever modifier and waveform has been programmed into it, from a clock pulse to an LFO to an envelope to a quantised pitch, so no one colour is true. The manual gives two different figures for the pulse thresholds, +2V rising with +0.1V falling in its voltage paragraph and +0.2V rising in the RUN and RESET paragraphs; the code settles it at 2V rising and 0.1V falling, the same pair for all three. Param 0 is the encoder and param 2 the SET button drawn on top of it, two pixels apart in the census; both can be clicked, because a click is resolved by which widget box contains the point and the button covers only its own centre. The menu also ends in a greyed License: full version (for everyone) label, which is not an item and gets no line.
